Editor's note—
Ord. No.
4760
, § 1, adopted April 19, 2021, repealed the former Art. VI., §§ 38-241—38-242, and
               enacted a new Art. VI as set out herein. The former Art. VI pertained to Trees and
               Shrubs and derived from 1960 Code, § 23-5, 23-6; 1981 Code, § 32-1, 32-6; Ord. No.
               2061, § 5, adopted May 21, 1984; Ord. No. 3912, § 1, adopted Oct. 4, 2004; and Ord.
               No. 4042, § 3, adopted Dec. 11, 2006.
